title: Pan-Seared Trout with Slovakian Crust
description: A delicious and healthy fish dish, topped with a crunchy Slovakian crust. Perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: nutty brown sugar
ingredients.notes: add a hint of nutty flavor

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt
ingredients.notes: use flaky sea salt for a delicate flavor

instructions: Season the trout fillets with flaky sea salt and a pinch of black pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together Slovakian wholemeal breadcrumbs, nutty brown sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Dip each trout fillet into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1-2 tbsp of oil and sear the trout fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Garnish with thinly sliced rainbow bell peppers and serve immediately.
